problems.title: A quadratic in a nonnegative square
problems.question: Find the real-root sum of (x²-2x+1)²-(x-1)²=2.
steps: Thus x=1±√2 and the root sum is 2.

problems.title: Nonnegative terms cannot cancel
problems.question: How many real roots has x²+x√x=0?
steps: For x>0 both terms are positive, so there are no other roots.

problems.title: Area from two medians
problems.question: Two triangle medians have lengths 9,8 and meet at 30°. Find the triangle area.
problems.idea: The centroid splits each median in ratio 2:1.
steps: The centroid-to-vertex lengths are 6 and 16/3. Their triangle area is (1/2)·6·(16/3)sin30°=8.
That centroid triangle is one third of the whole triangle.

problems.title: Roots on opposite sides of 1
problems.question: For which b does bx²-bx-3=0 have one root below 1 and one above?
formulas: f(1)=-3; for an upward quadratic, a negative value lies between its two roots.
steps: For b>0, f(1)<0 guarantees two real roots straddling 1.
For b<0, a downward quadratic would have to be positive between its roots, contradicting f(1)<0.
At b=0 the equation is -3=0, with no roots.

problems.title: A right triangle hidden in a trapezoid
problems.question: In trapezoid ABCD, AB=BC=AD/2. AC=2.4,CD=2.5. Find its area.
problems.idea: Let E be the midpoint of AD.
formulas: AB=BC=AE=ED; a diameter subtends a right angle.
steps: In triangle ACD, the given equal lengths imply AC⊥CD: with AB=BC=s, coordinate expansion gives AC·CD=0.
The trapezoid area is (AD+BC)/AD=3/2 times that triangle’s area, so it is 4.5.

problems.title: A discount numerically equal to the old price
problems.question: A fabric price falls by as many percent as its initial price in lari. The new price is 16 lari. Find the percentage reduction.
problems.idea: Let p be both the old price and the percentage number.
steps: Both 20 and 80 give a positive old price and a reduction below 100%.

problems.title: A system with a tangency solution
problems.question: Count real solutions of 2x²+y²=8, x²+y²+2x=0.
steps: At x=4, the second equation gives y²=-24, impossible. At x=-2 it gives y²=0.

problems.title: Products of opposite diagonal-triangle areas
problems.question: Diagonals split a convex quadrilateral into triangles of areas 10,20,30 and t, where t is the largest. Find total area.
problems.idea: Opposite small-triangle area products are equal.
steps: Depending on the pairing, t could be 20·30/10=60,10·30/20=15, or 10·20/30=20/3.
Only 60 is greater than all three known areas.

problems.title: A reciprocal quadratic has an attainable minimum
problems.question: Find the minimum of 1/(1-x)²+2/(1-x).
steps: It is attained at t=-1, which corresponds to x=2 and is in the original domain.

problems.title: Trapezoid height from four sides
problems.question: Find the area of a trapezoid with legs 2,4 and bases 1,5.
problems.idea: The base difference is 4; use the two horizontal projections.

problems.title: Perimeter from rectangle area and diagonal
problems.question: A rectangle has area 120 cm² and diagonal 17 cm. Find its perimeter.
problems.idea: Recover the side sum without solving for the sides.
steps: Thus a+b=23 and the perimeter is 46.

problems.title: A quadratic in x squared has no real input
problems.question: Count roots of x²+√2/x²=√5.
steps: Therefore there is no real t, and hence no real x.

problems.title: Trapezoid area from adjacent diagonal triangles
problems.question: In trapezoid ABCD with bases BC,AD, diagonal intersection K gives areas AKB=p and BKC=q. Find total area.
problems.idea: The other side triangle also has area p.
formulas: Opposite-base triangle areas have product p².

problems.title: Domain endpoints identify a quadratic
problems.question: The domain of y=√(-x²+mx-n) is [-1,2]. Find m+n.
problems.idea: The endpoints are the radicand roots.

problems.title: Intersect open quadratic intervals
problems.question: Solve 2x²<8 and x²+2x>0.
steps: Both endpoints are excluded by strict inequalities.

problems.title: Midpoints and complementary base angles
problems.question: A trapezoid’s two angles at its larger base sum to 90°. Legs are 1.5,2.4 cm. Find the area of the quadrilateral formed by the midpoints of both diagonals and both bases.
problems.idea: Its diagonals give one quarter of height times base difference.
steps: The midpoint-of-diagonals segment has length (B-b)/2. Its perpendicular crossing diagonal spans height h, so the area is h(B-b)/4.

problems.title: Distance between quadratic roots
problems.question: The roots of 2x²-2x+k=0 are distance 2 apart. Find k.

problems.title: Area cut by an angle bisector
problems.question: In ABC, AM is a median and BN a bisector; AB:BC=3:2. What fraction of area ABC is BNC?
formulas: AN/NC=AB/BC=3/2; same-altitude areas follow their base ratio.
steps: Triangles BNC and BAC share their altitude from B, so their area ratio is 2/5.

problems.title: Area of a median-bisector intersection triangle
problems.question: AM is a median, BN a bisector, K=AM∩BN, AB:BC=3:2. Find area BMK as a fraction of ABC.
steps: Thus KM/AM=1/4, so K is one quarter as high above BC as A.

problems.title: Compare a triangle with the remaining quadrilateral
problems.question: With AM median, BN bisector, K their intersection and AB:BC=3:2, find area ABK/area MKNC.
problems.idea: Express all areas as fractions of ABC.
steps: Thus area MKNC=3/20+1/8=11/40, and the ratio is (3/8)/(11/40)=15/11.

problems.title: Centroid quadrilateral area
problems.question: In convex ABCD, AC=12,BD=18 with angle 30°. Find the area of the quadrilateral of centroids of AOB,BOC,COD,DOA.
problems.idea: Its side vectors are thirds of the diagonals.
formulas: Adjacent centroid differences=(C-A)/3,(D-B)/3; parallelogram area=ab sinθ.
steps: The side lengths are 4 and 6 with angle 30° or its supplement.

problems.title: Minimize squared distance instead of distance
problems.question: For M=(a-4,a+1), find a minimizing its distance to the origin.
problems.idea: A square root increases, so minimize the squared distance.
steps: The squared term is smallest at a=3/2.
Therefore that value uniquely minimizes the distance.
problems.note: None of the printed values -2,1,0.5,3,0,2 equals 1.5.

problems.title: The width of an absolute-value solution interval
problems.question: Find greatest minus least solution of |2x-1|≤|x-2|.

problems.title: Five integers strictly inside a quadratic interval
problems.question: Find a so x²-2x-a<0 has exactly five integer solutions.
steps: To include the integers -1,0,1,2,3, require a+1>4.
To exclude the next two integers -2,4, require a+1≤9.

problems.title: Use the sum to find the product
problems.question: x²y+xy²=-4 and x+y=2. Find x²+y².
steps: Since x+y=2, the product is xy=-2.
